text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, the 'Miyako Stakes.'
This race is a bit different from the ones before.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: What differs above all else is...
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's a rival we need to keep an eye on.
Yeah, there's a rival we need to keep an eye on.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've been taking it easy up until now,
so this time, I'm deliberately taking on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's have a fair and square showdown between classmates!
"Yes, the same-generation rival running in today's race is—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho. Well then, guess I'd
better put my back into it.

—Wonder Acute.
An Umamusume who, for some reason, talks like an old granny.
However...
Her ability is not to be underestimated. She has already won two Dirt G3 races. Naturally, she possesses more than enough power to seize victory here as well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (A rival... Yes, this is exactly what I've been looking for...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(A race isn't something you complete alone.
By clashing with strong rivals,
unexpected synergy is born.)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(A two-way interaction.
Add an element of luck into that, and—)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(The "thrill" that I've been searching for
will definitely be born!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Accu-san!
Looking forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's actually entering the races she thinks Accu-san is likely to run in on purpose.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear. Well, I'm happy to hear that.
However~"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Please go easy on me~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, sorry, but
I'm not going easy on you~
'Cause I'm fully aiming to win...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wait—!
Ugh... Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Shoot. That might have been a tactical error.
The rivals are...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Talking like an old granny
kind of makes it hard to do things.

"I had forgotten. During summer training camp, I found out
that Transcend cares a whole lot about her grandmother."

"When the opponent is Wonder Acute, it might be tough
to fully switch into battle mode."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hoe-hoe...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuhoo...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Uuuu...

"Just standing next to them looked excruciatingly awkward.
Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! That's right, I'll do it.
That's why I came all this way.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
My very first race with Accu-san.
I'll seize the spark... for that thrilling rush!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-cha~n, get the camera ready, okay!
Don't forget the 'Cinema Gun', please!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Make sure you get a great shot with that! Of Accu-san running, and while you're at it... of me giving it my all, too!"
